prior_m8_assessment.relationship_to_this_addendum: That assessment remains valid and unchanged. This addendum records an independently supplied authoritative source identity as a future pre-open requirement; it does not claim that Codex verified the authoritative archive bytes.

authoritative_source_identity_required_f.provenance: Identity supplied from an independent verification of the authoritative Windows scientific archive outside this checkout.
authoritative_source_identity_required_f.future_fail_closed_gate: A future extraction utility must compute and exactly match both byte size and SHA-256 before opening the archive or reading any scientific array. A Git LFS pointer, size mismatch, or digest mismatch must abort before np.load or equivalent scientific-array access.

frozen_source_selection.rule: Select the earliest eligible contiguous 1000-ms interval from the frozen M8 trajectory.
frozen_source_selection.eligibility: The interval is eligible only if all required timestamps and all six selected physical_joint_position values exist as finite, unmodified source samples on the frozen 0.1-ms physics grid; provenance and dimensional checks must pass.
selection_independence: No outcome-dependent interval selection is permitted.
No inspection of candidate motor activity may influence interval selection.
Candidate recruitment execution and candidate recruitment outcomes must remain unavailable during extraction.

replay_payload.interval_semantics: The 1000 samples are control-interval inputs for the left-closed, right-open assay interval [0,1000) ms. The source state at 1000.0 ms is a boundary state and is not a 1001st replay input.
replay_payload.selection_method: Select exact existing physics rows at 10-row strides only, after proving their timestamps correspond to 0.0 through 999.0 ms at exactly 1.0-ms cadence. Copy the six specified columns without numerical transformation.

basis_in_frozen_protocol: The parent protocol defines runtime_ms=1000.0 and sensory_sample_ms=1.0.
Its analysis windows are explicitly left-closed and right-open: [0,250), [250,750), and [750,1000).
It assigns 500, 1000, and 500 neural steps to those windows at a 0.5-ms neural timestep, totaling 2000 neural transitions.
The selected SixTibiaRuntime implementation applies one observed sensory input per 1.0-ms control sample and advances two 0.5-ms neural steps for that input.
sample_count_resolution.reason_explicit_convention_is_frozen: The parent document specifies duration and cadence but does not enumerate replay timestamps or explicitly distinguish interval inputs from endpoint states. Freezing [0,1000) as 1000 inputs prevents a future extractor from treating the t=1000-ms boundary state as an extra input, which would contradict the frozen left-closed/right-open transition counts.
sample_count_resolution.boundary_state_policy: A t=1000.0-ms source state may be used only for provenance or validation and must not be included in the replay payload.

temporal_alignment_context_only.rule: M8 neural row i corresponds to physics row 5*(i+1) at the same 0.5-ms timestamp.
temporal_alignment_context_only.replay_data_rule: The replay consists only of the six physical_joint_position tibial angles. neural_sensory_encoded is not an angle source and must not be extracted into the replay.

interpretation_boundaries.physical_angles: The angles are FlyGym/MuJoCo measured joint coordinates.
interpretation_boundaries.sensory_transduction: Sensory transduction remains the existing modeled proprioceptive encoder.
interpretation_boundaries.biological_proprioception: This addendum does not establish biological proprioception.
interpretation_boundaries.recruitment_meaning: Future candidate recruitment means condition-dependent activity in the current MaleCNS runtime, not biological motor function.

authorization.authorized_after_source_identity_gate: Deterministic replay extraction only, using the frozen source selection and exact-copy rules in this addendum, after the authoritative M8 source byte size and SHA-256 have both been verified before scientific-array access.
not_authorized: recruitment scientific execution unless every other frozen prerequisite is satisfied
physics, FlyGym, MuJoCo, or neural-runtime execution
new motor decoder weights or coordinate signs
